Filament Cost Calculator

Free browser-based tool for 3D printed miniatures

Enter your filament roll price and weight, the grams your slicer reports for the print, and optionally the power draw and print time to see the estimated total cost. Works for PLA, PETG, and any filament type.

Features

Real-time cost calculation
Filament cost per print
Optional electricity cost estimate
Filament presets with real market data
Deep-link from scale engine
No account, no tracking

Disclaimer: This is an estimate

All values are approximations. Actual filament usage varies by purge tower, support material, raft, and slicer settings. Electricity cost depends on your local rate, printer efficiency, and whether the bed and nozzle reach full temperature for the entire print. This calculator is a planning aid only and has no legal or contractual value.
